hallucination.reason: The agent did not state any facts or details that are not covered by the approved knowledge base.

overclaim.reason: The agent did not guarantee or promise anything that is not allowed by the approved knowledge base.

interruption_recovery.reason: The conversation remained on track and the agent recovered well from any potential interruptions or diversions.

obedience.reason: The agent stayed within its role and knowledge base, providing relevant information and not inventing services or comparisons.

escalation.reason: The agent correctly offered to escalate or provide more information when necessary, without guessing or inventing details.
